# BaseJobQueue.destroy() method

Destroys the job queue, closing the broker connection and releasing its resources. Not reversible — construct a new queue to carry on.

**Signature:**

```typescript
destroy(): Promise<void>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;void&gt;
